purpose: Generate production MP3 and Opus for the four new U18 vocabulary IDs and six source-backed full-sentence examples. The existing B1 ID mengingatkan is reused and must not be requested as a new B2 audio ID.
texts: Suwono menyuruh anaknya pergi ke sekolah.
